title: Zyte Scrapy Cloud Student
description: Claim the GitHub Student Zyte offer and reach Scrapy Cloud without storing account identifiers, credentials, or crawler targets in the walkthrough.

steps.title: Open GitHub Student Developer Pack
steps.body: Open the Student Pack while signed into the GitHub account associated with your education eligibility.
steps.humanGate: Student verification, login, MFA, CAPTCHA and offer acceptance stay under your control.

steps.title: Find Zyte
steps.body: Use Find on page to highlight the Zyte offer if it is present in the current Student Pack layout.

steps.title: Open Zyte
steps.body: Continue through the provider claim or sign-in flow. Do not paste API keys or account secrets into CTRL Walkthrough.
steps.humanGate: Account creation, consent, terms, MFA/CAPTCHA and any paid upgrade require your confirmation.

steps.title: Locate Scrapy Cloud
steps.body: Once signed in, use Find on page to look for Scrapy Cloud or project controls. If the provider changes its UI, continue manually and the walkthrough can be updated later.

steps.title: Keep source permissions separate
steps.body: Crawler compute does not grant permission to access restricted material. Use it only for sources and data you are authorized to collect.
